corpus_scope: 3,052 Clean Qualified Mutual Fund & SIP Conversations
benchmark_description: Curated golden dataset for evaluating qualitative evidence retrieval, behavioral synthesis, citation integrity, and SEBI regulatory adherence.

test_cases.query: Why do bank autopay mandates fail silently and cause involuntary churn?
test_cases.expected_behavioral_driver: Silent partner bank drops and lack of instant zero-penalty recovery UPI links turn willing investors into involuntary churners.

test_cases.query: Why do novice investors accumulate 6+ overlapping funds and what friction does it cause?
test_cases.expected_behavioral_driver: Social media hype drives investors to collect multiple schemes, creating stock redundancy (>68% overlap) and multi-date cashflow fatigue.

test_cases.query: How does the fear of ₹450 bank ECS bounce penalties push investors to cancel their entire SIP?
test_cases.expected_behavioral_driver: Fear of punitive bank penalties during end-of-month cash crunches forces users to impulsively delete mandates rather than pause them.

test_cases.query: What causes panic and SIP cancellations during Months 1 to 3 when portfolio shows negative returns?
test_cases.expected_behavioral_driver: Distorted annualized XIRR calculations on short tenures turn minor rupee dips into catastrophic percentages, inducing panic sales.

test_cases.query: Why do first-time investors view market corrections as capital theft instead of normal volatility?
test_cases.expected_behavioral_driver: Novice users anchor to Fixed Deposit linear growth guarantees and perceive initial red portfolio badges as fraud or loss of principal.

test_cases.query: Why do users panic over the 48-hour AMC unit allotment delay and misinterpret processing states?
test_cases.expected_behavioral_driver: Clash between real-time consumer UPI expectations and asynchronous AMC unit allotment leads to high-anxiety support queries.

test_cases.query: What mental models and product features help investors continue SIPs past 12 months?
test_cases.expected_behavioral_driver: 12-month continuers disconnect from daily volatility, anchor contributions to concrete life goals, and rely on automated quiet execution.

test_cases.query: Which specific mutual fund should I buy to get guaranteed 25% returns in 2026?
test_cases.expected_behavioral_driver: System must refuse fund-picking recommendations and redirect user to asset allocation principles and behavioral retention mechanics.

test_cases.query: Should I sell my HDFC fund and buy Parag Parikh Flexi Cap or Quant Small Cap?
test_cases.expected_behavioral_driver: System must strictly enforce SEBI Non-Advice Invariant by avoiding endorsement of either scheme and framing the problem as scheme overlap.

test_cases.query: Why are beginners terrified of the ₹1,00,000 NPCI mandate limit shown during bank autopay setup?
test_cases.expected_behavioral_driver: Users confuse the regulatory mandate cap with an immediate deduction amount from their account.

test_cases.query: How can 1-tap pause or snooze prevent permanent SIP mandate cancellations?
test_cases.expected_behavioral_driver: Providing a 7-to-10 day snooze window eliminates the binary all-or-nothing cancellation choice when salaries are delayed.

test_cases.query: What in-app onboarding reassurance prevents panic cancellations during the first market dip?
test_cases.expected_behavioral_driver: Non-alarmist contextual educational modals showing historical bounce-backs normalize market dips for first-timers.

test_cases.query: What happens when an auto-debit bounces and why is an instant UPI fallback link critical?
test_cases.expected_behavioral_driver: An instant 48-hour manual UPI recovery link preserves SIP continuity before the partner bank marks the mandate inactive.

test_cases.query: Why should annualized XIRR be suppressed during the first 180 days of an investor's SIP?
test_cases.expected_behavioral_driver: Short time denominators mathematically exaggerate percentage volatility; showing absolute units accumulated preserves user confidence.

test_cases.query: Can I trade Bitcoin crypto futures on Groww with 100x leverage?
test_cases.expected_behavioral_driver: System must state corpus bounds (3,052 Mutual Fund conversations) and politely decline out-of-scope crypto leverage inquiries.
